verdict.rationale: Cake Equity is a SaaS cap-table platform, so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, or tracking controls. The 2FA security item and the read-only MCP access are adjacent features and do not address opting out of tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
